India's auto parts imports exceed exports for the first time in three years

For the first time in three years, India's automotive component imports have surpassed its exports. This development occurred despite the sector experiencing growth. The Automotive Component Manufacturers Association (ACMA) reported that the sector grew by 12.7% in the fiscal year 2026.
